question_text: Between 1975 and 1985 , the volume of all iron and steel in a given automobile model decreased from $0.162 \mathrm{~m}^3$ to $0.116 \mathrm{~m}^3$. In the same time frame, the volume of all aluminum alloys increased from $0.012 \mathrm{~m}^3$ to $0.023 \mathrm{~m}^3$. Using the densities of pure Fe and Al , estimate the mass reduction resulting from this trend in materials substitution. Give your answer as the value of mass_reduction.The unit of the answer is kg.
